The '''New Mandalorian Minister of Finance''' was a member of the [[Ruling Council (New Mandalorians)/Legends|Ruling Council]], a council of officials charged with governing the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorians]] faction of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]]. She and the other ministers were present at the New Mandalorian [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] to discuss the problem of closed trade routes and their reliance on the corrupt black market as a result of the raging war.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
